描述_EN: it was almost certainly acquired from a temple in the north-west of beijing, founded under kublai khan and known in the ming period as the da long shan hu guo si ('temple of great and mighty benevolence that protects the dynasty'). an inscription at the bottom of the scroll dates it to the 15th year of the chenghua emperor, equivalent to 1479. tibetan and nepalese monks living in beijing under imperial patronage influenced chinese buddhist art from the time of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368) established by kublai khan (1215-1294). the fierce deities depicted are powerful protectors of buddhism, brandishing a variety of weapons and trampling triumphantly on prone demons. it may have been made by a temple monk. darkened by smoke from incense burned in its former temple setting, this mandala is of a style that owes much to tibetan (and through them, nepalese) styles of buddhist iconography. throughout the ming dynasty (1368-1644), this temple was a centre for tibetan buddhist teaching, and it served as a lodging for many eminent monks. this is a mandala or meditational diagram.
描述_ZN: 几乎可以肯定的是，它是从北京西北的一座寺庙中获得的，该寺庙是在忽必烈汗时期建立的，在明代被称为大龙山胡国寺（"保护王朝的伟大而强大的仁慈的寺庙"）。 卷轴底部的铭文显示它是成化15年的作品，相当于1479年。 生活在北京的西藏和尼泊尔僧侣在皇室的赞助下，从忽必烈（1215-1294）建立的元朝（1279-1368）时期就影响了中国的佛教艺术。 所描绘的凶猛的神灵是强大的佛教保护者，他们挥舞着各种武器，胜利地践踏着俯卧的恶魔。 它可能是由一个寺庙的僧侣制作的。 在以前的寺庙环境中被烧香的烟熏黑了，这个曼陀罗的风格在很大程度上得益于西藏（以及通过他们，尼泊尔）的佛教图标风格。 在整个明代（1368-1644），该寺是西藏佛教的教学中心，也是许多著名僧人的住处。 这是个曼陀罗或冥想图。
